name: TC-866: @scenario S4 Any 2 medium pizzas for $19.99 — two 'Any item from <category>' lines; paid toppings show as upgrades
description: Build: Combo price → search the per-run pizza category and pick 'Any item from' it, twice (each line reads 'Customer picks 1 from <category> · 2 items'), $19.99, Save and turn on. Read back: two category lines on that category. Edit: price → $20.99. Lima + wind: Margherita + Extra cheese (+$1.50) and Pepperoni (the pricier pizza) + Mushrooms (+$1) → deal $20.99, upgrades $2.50 itemised, Items + Upgrades = Subtotal, You're saving = $30 − $20.99.
